windows.coordinate: 相对 MIDI NoteOn 的秒数；半开区间；不得跨入 NoteOff。
windows.boundary: 本时间线 W2 终点等于 NoteOff 时刻 4.2 s；端点采用半开区间，不静默纳入释放段。

decision.window_usage: Use exactly the registered W1 and W2; half-open; relative to MIDI NoteOn; never cross NoteOff.
decision.release_tail_policy: excluded from every formal evaluation metric and decision

absolute_timeline.note: Derived from the registered stimulus timeline; per-unit origin-certified sample spans are still required before formal evaluation.

formal_evaluation_rule: All formal metrics are computed only inside the registered W1 and W2.
Do not include any sample at or after NoteOff in a formal metric.
Do not add a release-tail tolerance, tail metric, or bit-identity requirement to formal classification.
Do not modify W1, W2, or any numeric budget after any rendering or inspection.
Report release-tail diagnostics separately and label them non-adjudicative.
Per-unit origin-certified sample spans remain mandatory; this decision does not replace them.

reasoning.observed_divergence: 36/60 full-file repeat pairs differ only after NoteOff; all 60 pairs are PCM-identical through at least 4.2102 s absolute.
reasoning.why_exclude: Both registered windows end at or before NoteOff. W2 ends at NoteOff (4.2 s absolute); the earliest observed divergence is 10.2 ms after NoteOff, so it lies outside both windows.
reasoning.why_not_shorten: Shortening W2 would modify the preregistered window and reduce comparability. The registered W2 already excludes the observed release-tail divergence.
reasoning.why_not_tail_tolerance: A tolerance would create a new, post-hoc decision surface and an unregistered threshold; the tail is diagnostic only.

authorization: User instructed: analyze carefully and directly adopt the best formal adjudication rule.
